  {"step":4,"file":"ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c","function":"tls_process_ske_dhe","line":2150,"var":"dh","code":"EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh) transfers ownership to the EVP_PKEY wrapper","note":"After assignment, peer_tmp aliases the same DH heap object."},
  {"step":5,"file":"ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c","function":"tls_process_ske_dhe","line":2178,"var":"dh/peer_tmp","code":"On later validation failure the err path frees both DH and peer_tmp","note":"If the object was already attached elsewhere, the wrapper can become stale."},
  {"step":6,"file":"ssl/s3_lib.c","function":"ssl3_clear","line":3344,"var":"s->s3.peer_tmp","code":"Connection cleanup frees s->s3.peer_tmp again when the SSL object is torn down","note":"The same wrapper is released during teardown."},

]
